style: 3D animated, Pixar quality, hard sun, high exposure
motion_rule: the hermit crab moves his whole body from rock to rock every beat; waves, foam and spray never stop; the camera orbits the crab nonstop, new shot size every beat; the crab fills half the frame outside close-ups
character: the crab: small hermit crab, long eyestalks, one oversized claw, wearing a glossy pink ceramic piggy bank with a coin slot as his shell, no markings; ONE tiny octopus inspector in a plain peaked cap, no badge, wide toothy grin, lives inside it, until 6.5 only ONE eye blinking in the slot, tentacle in a white shirt cuff
props: ONE piggy bank; ONE blank sheet from 7.2
environment: rocky sea edge at low tide: big wet ochre boulders with deep cracks, breaking waves, white foam, spray, wet sand
lighting: glints on wet rock, glossy pink ceramic

audio.delivery: raspy small male voice, nervous, 4.7 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: mne ka-ZA-los', ya ot na-LO-go-voy PRYA-chus'. o-ka-ZA-los', shto o-NI u-ZHE DA-zhe v moy PAN-tsir' za-LEZ-li
audio.pacing: 0.35-6.5 one continuous flow, no pause inside; after 6.5 not a word, sfx go on
audio.sfx: sand spray, wave crash, ceramic scrape, paper flutter, ceramic knocks

timeline.a: a wave bursts into foam on the boulders; the crab in the piggy bank shoots out of the foam onto a wet boulder; ONE eye blinks in the slot
timeline.c: low at the waterline, orbit right

timeline.a: the crab crams into a crack too small for the piggy bank, it bangs on the rock, eyestalks and mouthparts filling the frame; foam swirls round his legs
timeline.c: close-up orbit, spray in the foreground

timeline.a: he bursts out of the crack into the foreground, eyestalks whirling and filling the frame, then scuttles to the next crack as spray douses the rock
he scrambles diagonally over the boulder's crest away from camera, the piggy bank wobbling; the slot eye blinks twice
he backs shell-first into a narrow crack, it jams halfway, all legs shoving, the piggy bank grinding; a wave foams over his legs
he backs out and scuttles in a curve round the boulder, eyestalks twisted back at the piggy bank; the slot eye blinks after him
ONE tentacle in a cuff whips out of the slot and shoves; the piggy bank tips over, the crab tumbles out with his pale curled tail end and rolls across the sand, legs flailing
timeline.c: sand level, orbit with the roll

timeline.a: the octopus squeezes out of the slot pulling ONE blank sheet and slaps over to thrust it at the crab, who snatches it with both claws
the crab backs diagonally away from camera across the sand, holding the sheet in both claws beside his body, flat and square to camera, trembling, eyestalks quivering above it; foam washes past
the octopus on the tipped piggy bank slaps it and lunges up close, grin filling the frame; in front, the crab backs off, shaking the sheet
timeline.c: close-up, low angle, orbit right, spray in the foreground

timeline.a: the crab wraps the sheet round his tail end like a shell and scuttles off over the boulders, eyestalks back at the grinning octopus; a wave hits

negative_prompt: microphone, extra characters, slow motion, any word after 6.5, silent tail, accented Russian, letters, numbers, subtitles, watermark, English speech, extra word, duplicate props, floating objects, a stamp, far shot, night, cut, scene change
